<script lang="ts">
  import OgNode from './OgNode.svelte';
  import { gridDefaults, resolveProps, type GridProps } from '../registry.js';
  import { gridTemplate } from '../templates/definitions.js';

</script>
<OgNode node={gridTemplate(resolved)} {overlay} />
